messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Ortega <tom.ortega@acme.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff - Acme / Redwood (recap & next steps)

Hi Samantha -

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a short recap of the pain points you described, our proposed scope for the pilot, and the immediate access items we need to start. Please confirm any gaps or corrections.

Pain points learned today:
- Support agents frequently see duplicate/near-duplicate tickets; current KB search returns noisy matches (low precision).
- Retrieval pipeline latency spikes during peak hours (~800ms median under load).
- Current vendor costs are high and unpredictable; team wants to reduce per-query cost.

POC goals (4-week pilot):
1) Improve relevance on KB-driven support prompts (target: >85% precision on agreed eval set).
2) Achieve median inference latency <250ms in staging under representative load.
3) Reduce per-query token/unit cost by ~3x versus your baseline, or identify optimal quality/cost tradeoffs.

Proposed timeline & scope:
- Week 0 (2027-07-05): access & infra setup (S3, credentials, security contact).
- Week 1: baseline runs on the 10k sample and initial metric capture (latency, cost, accuracy).
- Week 2: prompt tuning, retrieval config changes, run evals on 30-50 prompt set.
- Week 3: quality regressions, short load test to validate latency SLOs.
- Week 4: handover, recommendations (batching/quantization/routing), and draft SOW for production.

Deliverables & success metrics:
- Baseline vs. tuned metrics (latency distribution, cost/unit, precision/recall).
- Prompt set (30-50 prompts), evaluation harness, and synthetic test cases.
- Integration checklist and recommended config for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (POC PM), Rishi Malhotra (technical lead), Aditya Rao (infra).
- Acme: Samantha Chen (product lead), Tom Ortega (technical lead).

Immediate access/setup items we need from Acme:
1) Staging S3 bucket or data upload (presigned URLs acceptable).
2) AWS account ID or short-lived cross-account read-only role (if you prefer).
3) 3-5 labeled examples (good/bad answers) for initial accuracy scoring.
4) Security/network POC for VPC peering or private deployment (Lauren Park as referenced).

Attachments I will share: POC SOW (draft) and an internal access checklist. Proposed weekly check-in cadence: 30 minutes every Wednesday.

If that looks good, we can start Week 0 on 2027-07-05. Please confirm and share the account details or presigned URLs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
